# Practical report content instructions

- Write in formal academic Indonesian.
- Follow the supplied module and lecturer's instructions.
- Keep the standard report sections unless the assignment specifies otherwise.
- Do not invent implementation evidence, test results, screenshots, or observations.
- Use IEEE citations and the meeting-local `references.bib`.
- Make sure every citation key exists in the bibliography.
- Use meaningful image filenames and captions.
- Keep the report's metadata accurate and meeting-specific.
